نختفي (form VIII)
# نَخْتَفِي (naḵtafī) /nax.ta.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# نَخْتَفِيَ (naḵtafiya) /nax.ta.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
